text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing patterns, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being explicitly programmed. Deep learning, a more advanced form of machine learning, uses complex neural networks to handle tasks like image and speech recognition. You already interact with AI every day. It powers virtual assistants like Siri or Alexa, recommends videos or products online, filters spam emails, and helps cars drive safely. As AI improves, it will become an even bigger part of our lives, from healthcare to education.
